backpack.ui: compact backpack icon opens 4x5 overlay grid
backpack.note: Currencies/counters should not consume item slots.

musicCollection.role: persistent track unlock collection in Session/Journey/Fractal Almanac
musicCollection.homeDisplayCandidate: cassette shelf / tape recorder / car-radio-tape-player donor

acquisitionModes.note: Physical cassette may be shown/handed off but need not stay in Backpack.

flow: find cassette/demo tape in chest/lootbox/world POI
acquisitionModes.note: Track becomes playable globally after discovery.

flow: band/vendor offers tape for currency or another object
acquisitionModes.note: User mentions Pop/Popcorn/Westing terminology; exact currency owner/name was not proven in current repository search and must be pinned before runtime.

radio.invariant: one music core / one audio lifecycle; no second universal radio engine

presentationAdapters.vehicle: existing compact kinetic radio presentation may be reused
presentationAdapters.race: same Jukebox/Music Bus behind Race presentation
presentationAdapters.home: physical cassette/tape-player display may control same catalog

rotation.randomPolicy: seeded/random playlist policy belongs to Jukebox presentation, not track asset

liveVsRadio.liveBand: diegetic spatial music source in world zone
liveVsRadio.rule: never let full radio and live band play at full level simultaneously
liveVsRadio.firstPolicy: duck/fade global radio when entering a live performance zone; restore on exit
liveVsRadio.laterOption: phase/sync crossfade between global and spatial version of same track if proven useful

trackLoopMeta.rule: Do not spend Suno stem credits just to establish loopability; author loop metadata/crossfade around full mix first.

largeOrcDrums.rhythm: quarter-note / beat grid with alternating L/R hands
largeOrcDrums.accent: pulse can increase strike amplitude or add double-hit/shoulder recoil
largeOrcDrums.motionOwner: procedural Rig_Large percussion adapter already identified in Orc Band concept

mediumOrcGuitar.rhythm: eighth-note or selected subdivision from bpm
mediumOrcGuitar.accent: pulse/level modulates strum amplitude and body groove
mediumOrcGuitar.motionOwner: measured Animatronic guitar-hold + procedural-strum donor adapted to Orc Raider

legacyFrontman.rhythm: body bounce / sway from beat and level
legacyFrontman.variation: seeded gesture/hype beat every N bars
legacyFrontman.prop: microphone may remain held in one hand; no singing animation required for instrumental track

orcBandVisualizer.firstGate: visual plausibility to full mix beat/pulse; instrument-specific stem following is deferred

buyDownloadCreditsOnlyIf: full-mix beat/pulse cannot make drum strikes believable
guitar and drums need independently timed accents for the selected final track
a selected track is promoted as a recurring signature band performance
stemsPolicy.note: Do not download stems for all six candidates.

steps: register candidate track with bpm/loop metadata sidecar
drive three animation adapters from beat/level/pulse
track unlock commits to Almanac music collection
same track becomes selectable on global Radio/Jukebox
cassette visual is optional/display-oriented and does not consume a Backpack slot

explicitNonGoals: blocking WorldBuilder P1/P2 on this music lane
